current_activity: The 560th Volksgrenadier Division attacks toward the Our bridges at Ouren
notes: Event date: CMH Ardennes ch. 8 p. 195: "The 560th Volks Grenadier Division (Generalmajor Rudolf Langhaeuser) was assigned two specific bridges as targets, one just north of Ouren, the other a stone arch a little to the south of the village"; Nafziger 944GLAA (15 December 1944): "560th Volks Grenadier Division: Oberst R. Langhauser". Event definition: the opening of the offensive on 16 December. Event support: two source families: CMH and Nafziger. Location: Ouren with a precision of 10 km, the village the bridge targets lay by. Location approximate: a village point. Location support: CMH names Ouren. Commander: Generalmajor Rudolf Langhaeuser. Opponents: US VIII Corps (112th Infantry).

location_qualifier: division sector on the II SS Panzer Corps front opposite the US VII Corps
current_activity: 560th Volks Grenadier Division (about 2,500 men) holds the centre of the sector opposite the US VII Corps
notes: Event date: CMH The Last Offensive ch. 2 p. 27: "the 12th Volks Grenadier Division opposite the left wing of the corps, the 560th Volks Grenadier Division in the center, and the 2d SS Panzer Division opposite the right wing"; p. 28: "strengths varied from 2,500 men in the 560th to 6,000 in the panzer division". Event definition: the situation on the eve of the First Army attack of 3 January. Event support: one source family (CMH). Location: Houffalize with a precision of 25 km, the town that was the objective of the VII Corps; the division position is given as a wing of the corps front only. Location approximate: the town of Houffalize for a division sector. Location support: CMH names the position within the II SS Panzer Corps front. Commander: unknown. Opponents: US VII Corps.
